faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kerala University Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Assistant Professor positions at Kerala University is 31st August 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree with a minimum of 55% marks in the concerned, relevant, or allied subject. Additionally, a NET qualification or a Ph.D. in the subject is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, there is usual relaxation in the upper age limit for candidates belonging to SC/ST and OBC categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for different categories?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General/OBC and PwBD candidates, and Rs. 250 for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two main stages: scrutiny of applications submitted by candidates and a subsequent interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 45,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for the Kerala University Assistant Professor recruitment must be submitted online only through the official website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Kerala University Assistant Professor recruitment is 34249/Ad D I/2026/UOK.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Assistant Professor position at Kerala University is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' description.
